questions.question: What is writing?
options: The act of creating a persistent, usually visual representation of language on a surface
The act of speaking to another person
The act of reading a text aloud
The act of memorizing a spoken language
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states: 'Writing is the act of creating a persistent, usually visual representation of language on a surface.'
Incorrect. The article defines writing as creating a representation of language, not speaking.
Incorrect. Reading is described as encountering a text and construing its symbols, not writing.
Incorrect. Writing is about creating a visual representation, not memorizing a language.

questions.question: What is written language also known as?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says: 'As a structured system of communication, writing is also known as written language.'
Incorrect. Spoken language is what written language records, not what written language is called.
Incorrect. A script is a set of symbols, not another name for written language.
Incorrect. A tactile alphabet is a rare form of writing, not another name for written language.

questions.question: Historically, written languages have emerged as a way to record what?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states: 'Historically, written languages have emerged as a way to record corresponding spoken languages.'
Incorrect. Visual representations are part of the definition of writing, not what written languages record.
Incorrect. Tactile symbols are a rare form of writing, not what written languages record.
Incorrect. Cognitive processes are part of the activity of writing, not what written languages record.

questions.question: What is a particular set of symbols called?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says: 'A particular set of symbols, called a script, as well as the rules by which they encode a particular spoken language, is known as a writing system.'
Incorrect. A writing system includes the script and the rules, but the set of symbols itself is called a script.
Incorrect. A language is what writing represents, not the set of symbols.
Incorrect. A text is the physical output of writing, not the set of symbols.

questions.question: What is known as a writing system?
options: A script and the rules by which it encodes a spoken language
A set of symbols without rules
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states: 'A particular set of symbols, called a script, as well as the rules by which they encode a particular spoken language, is known as a writing system.'
Incorrect. A writing system includes both the script and the rules, not just symbols.
Incorrect. A spoken language is what is encoded, not the writing system itself.
Incorrect. A physical process is part of the activity of writing, not the writing system.

questions.question: In some rare cases, writing may be what instead of visual?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says: 'In some rare cases, writing may be tactile rather than visual.'
Incorrect. Auditory is not mentioned as a form of writing.
Incorrect. Digital is a way symbols are represented, but not an alternative to visual in this context.
Incorrect. Mechanical is a way symbols are transferred, but not an alternative to visual in this context.

questions.question: What is the activity of encountering a text and construing its symbols?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states: 'Reading is the activity of encountering a text and construing its symbols.'
Incorrect. Writing is the act of creating a representation, not encountering a text.
Incorrect. Literacy is the ability of reading and writing, not the activity itself.
Incorrect. Speaking is not mentioned in this context.

questions.question: What is literacy?
options: The ability of reading and writing
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says: 'Literacy is the ability of reading and writing.'
Incorrect. Writing is an act, not the ability.
Incorrect. Reading is an activity, not the ability.
Incorrect. Speaking is not mentioned as part of literacy.

questions.question: What is the physical output of writing also called?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states: 'whose physical output is also called writing (or a text).'
Incorrect. A script is a set of symbols, not the physical output.
Incorrect. A writing system is the script plus rules, not the physical output.
Incorrect. A language is what writing represents, not the physical output.

questions.question: What do writing systems do?
options: Represent language durably so it can be understood later
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says: 'writing systems... a durable means of representing language such that it can be understood by people at a later time.'
Incorrect. Writing systems complement spoken language, not replace it.
Incorrect. Writing systems represent existing languages, not create new ones.
Incorrect. Reading is still necessary to understand the text.
